paragraphs: Rabbi Abba Kahana, and Rabbi Abbahu, were in the time of Rabbi Yochanan and Rav. Perhaps he was the son of Rav Kahana, Rav’s student. I have found no mention of him; perhaps it should read “bar Kahana.”
